title: FIFA World Cup Winners Quiz
description: Think you know your FIFA World Cup history? Test your knowledge of World Cup winners, record-breakers, and iconic moments from 1930 to 2022. From Uruguay's first-ever triumph to Argentina's glory in Qatar, this football trivia quiz covers every champion, top scorer, and unforgettable final. Perfect for football fans who love a challenge. How many can you get right?

questions.text: Which country won the very first FIFA World Cup in 1930?

tiers.label: World Cup Legend
tiers.description: Outstanding! You're a true FIFA World Cup legend. Your knowledge of football history is exceptional — from Uruguay's pioneering triumph in 1930 to Argentina's emotional victory in Qatar 2022, you know it all. Whether it's Brazil's record five titles, Germany's tactical masterclasses, or Italy's back-to-back glory, no World Cup trivia challenge can stop you. The beautiful game's history is in safe hands.
